correctness.rationale: The exact H_t=rI+B P+C P² identity follows from P³=P and is checked algebraically. For q=α+β<1, all zeros stay zero and active sites move only in whole-part blocks; q>1 follows by complement symmetry, q=1 is stationary. Thus after two updates no further change is possible. Exact rational values r=3/20 on K_(2,3) give a two-stage trajectory. Stars and K_(2,2) cannot have two stages by the one-block density argument. The finite exact-rational code was run successfully and is corroborative; the proof does not rest on exhaustive finite tests.
